scope: Progress ledger, not a claim of exhaustive IUCN/DENR review; most records remain explicitly unverified. Original RC18 dated assessments may be older than current edition. Photo indicator covers only original offline photo manifest, not the separately staged 49 licensed media items.
policy: Unknown is not Least Concern, not zero and not absent. Do not conflate national and global, treat historic specimen as current site detection, or assume a taxon photo is a validated differential.
